mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_refresh_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, is_revoked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, is_revoked AS revoked, revoked_at FROM tbl_refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_refresh_token SET is_revoked = 1, revoked_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tbl_refresh_token SET is_revoked = 1, revoked_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_revoked = 0
